product_one_liner.value: Auterion provides an AI-powered operating system and autonomy software that enables governments and enterprises to operate autonomous air, land, and sea platforms.
product_one_liner.notes: Auterion describes its AI-powered solutions, AuterionOS, and modular autonomy stack for air, land, and sea platforms serving governments, enterprises, and defense forces. Sources: https://auterion.com/auterion-raises-130-million-series-b-as-their-ai-enabled-software-powering-low-cost-commercial-hardware-at-scale-transforms-warfare and https://auterion.com/auterion-introduces-nemyx-vertical-launch-system-for-drones-from-any-vendor.

pricing_page.notes: The public Auterion Suite page contains a pricing section, including a Basic plan at $0 with vehicle and user limits: https://auterion.com/enterprise/suite.

founded_year.notes: Auterion's company profile explicitly lists its founding year as 2017: https://linkedin.com/company/auterion.

eng_blog.notes: Two substantive how-built articles meet the criterion. 'Enabling navigation with limited or no GPS signal' is authored by Auterion Computer Vision Engineer Kamil Ritz and explains stereo-camera visual-inertial odometry: https://auterion.com/enabling_uav_navigation_in_environments_with_limited_or_no_gps_signal/. 'Smarter autonomous UAV missions' credits an Auterion software engineer and autonomy lead and explains collision-prevention algorithms, acceleration limits, and tracking delay: https://auterion.com/making_autonomous_uav_missions_smarter/.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site covers fleet operation, mission planning, application development, hardware integration, setup, and diagnostics, with links to multiple guides rather than a single FAQ. Source: https://docs.auterion.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Senior Computer Vision Engineer posting describes building and deploying onboard perception systems, and the position appears in the current job board. Posting: https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/auterion/jobs/8742077002. Current board: https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/auterion/jobs.

model_provider.value: Spleenlab — VISIONAIRY AI software, publicly described as deployable on Auterion's Skynode and AI Node.
model_provider.notes: Auterion publicly names Spleenlab's ML algorithms and VISIONAIRY AI software as deployable on its hardware. The answer preserves that integration context rather than claiming every Auterion product uses this provider or identifying an unsupported LLM provider. Source: https://auterion.com/ai-running-onboard-drones.
